note: All thresholds for the live What-happened story in one reviewable file (docs/review/LIVE_STORY_SPEC.md section 2). Read by tools/build_story.py.

flooded_mandal.rule_text: A mandal counts as 'flooded' if likely new open water is at least 3% of its area, AND at least 2 times its normal-fortnight water share, AND radar covered at least 50% of it. Only the water class is used for headline claims: the wet-crops class is not separable from normal field change (docs/METHODS.md). Below 50% coverage the mandal is shown as 'not enough radar view' and is never ranked.

change_vs_previous_pass.rule_text: Report 'went down' or 'went up' only if the change is larger than 2 times the error (and at least 1 percentage point). Anything inside that band is 'no clear change'.

worse.note: more flooded mandals now than on the previous pass

first_pass.note: no previous pass to compare with

no_new_pass.note: no scene newer than the one already shown

radar_finding.rule_text: A radar pass is recorded as 'change_seen' only if at least one mandal meets the flooded rule above, or at least one mandal went up since the previous pass. Otherwise it is 'no_clear_change'. The public headline and the event record use this same basis. 'numbers_coming', 'no_baseline' and 'sea_no_public_finding' are unchanged.

stale_note: NISAR repeat is 12 days; 16 = 12 + 4 days grace. After that the page says 'No new radar pass in {days} days' and shows the last pass date.

state_rules.event: an event file with status 'active' and landfall within monitor_window_days
state_rules.recovery: an active event past its first radar passes, still inside monitor_window_days
state_rules.watch: no active event inside monitor_window_days and no new flood signal

banned_words_note: Case-insensitive whole-word match on every generated string. The fixed radar-limits sentence (findings.js mandal.cannot) names these ideas only to deny them and is exempt.
event_stub_policy: Auto-created stubs have status 'needs_review' and never publish text until a human sets status to 'active'.

quiet.rule_text: A pass is 'quiet' if no mandal crosses the flooded rule, AND no mandal went up or down since the previous pass (change inside the error band), AND the likely new open water share of land is at most 2 times the normal-fortnight control. If all three hold the page says there is no clear change; no story is invented.

season_policy.other: no_baseline: the baseline is never reused across a distant season
season_policy.rule_text: Seasons come from data/seasons.json (month ranges, cyclic order). Same season as the baseline: normal. The next or previous season: numbers are shown with lower confidence and a caveat. Any other season: no baseline, no change numbers. A different track always has no baseline unless config/areas.json lists one.

default_baseline.note: Used only when config/areas.json is absent.
